name: Sequence and trim video clips
task: Using a tool you know, trim and arrange three clips into a 30-second sequence. Export and review the result.

name: Caption spoken video
task: Caption a 30-second clip in Premiere Pro. Correct the transcript and verify that every caption is readable and timed correctly.

name: Publish content on a Facebook Page
task: Prepare and preview a Facebook Page video post with a caption and appropriate audience. Use a test Page or save a draft if you lack publishing permission.

name: Interpret Facebook Page analytics
task: Using Page Insights you have permission to access, compare two posts and write three observations and one next step. Do not share private audience data.

name: Plan a Facebook ad campaign
task: Create a draft Facebook ad brief with objective, audience, creative and budget limit. Do not publish or spend money.

name: Prepare Instagram Reels
task: Prepare a Reel draft and caption for Instagram. Review the preview without publishing.

name: Lay out a readable flyer
task: Create an event flyer in Canva with readable details and export it for mobile viewing.

name: Build an event run sheet
task: Create a run sheet for a small event with times, owners and three backup plans.

name: Structure semantic HTML
task: Create a semantic HTML page with a heading, introduction and contact section. Check heading order and link names.

name: Build responsive CSS layouts
task: Style a page with CSS. Verify readable text and no horizontal overflow at 375px and 1024px widths.

name: Write step-by-step technical instructions
task: Write a short onboarding guide for a technical task. State the audience, prerequisites, numbered steps and how to verify success. Test it with a colleague.

name: Explain technical concepts for an audience
task: Write a short onboarding guide for a technical task. State the audience, prerequisites, numbered steps and how to verify success. Test it with a colleague.

name: Demonstrate and explain working code
task: Choose a short program you understand. Explain its input, logic and output. Show a common error and how to debug it, then give the learner a small modification to try.

name: Guide a learner with feedback
task: Guide a colleague through a small coding problem. Ask questions before supplying answers, give specific feedback and check that they can solve a similar problem independently.
